Agents:
- Agent: Planner
  -- Action: Analyzed the task to determine which battle occurred earlier and decided to engage WebSurfer.
  -- Observation: No prior results existed; task requires dates for Belleau Wood and Peleliu.
  -- Thought: Need authoritative dates for both battles to compare. Prioritized Britannica, History.com, and USMC sources.
  -- Result: Instructed WebSurfer to search for Belleau Wood and Peleliu dates from authoritative sources.
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Searched for "Battle of Belleau Wood dates Britannica History.com Marine Corps history".
  -- Observation: Found Britannica stating Belleau Wood occurred June 1-26, 1918; History.com confirming June 6, 1918 start.
  -- Thought: Belleau Wood dates are confirmed as 1918. Need Peleliu dates next.
  -- Result: Provided Belleau Wood dates (June 1–26, 1918) and cited sources.

  target_agent: WebSurfer
  data_item: "Belleau Wood dates (June 1–26, 1918)"
  data_type: text
  transformation: "extraction from search results"
  correctness: correct
  confidence: 0.95
